# Akamai TechDocs
> Technical documentation, API references, and implementation guides for Akamai products and services.

Akamai TechDocs provides product documentation for security, delivery, compute, cloud networking, APIs, CLI tools, and developer workflows across the Akamai platform.

## Getting Started
- [TechDocs Home](https://techdocs.akamai.com/): Entry point for Akamai technical documentation across products and services.
- [Akamai Developer](https://developer.akamai.com/): Developer portal for APIs, tools, authentication, and platform onboarding.
- [API Overview](https://developer.akamai.com/api): Overview of Akamai APIs, use cases, and developer resources.
- [Open API Definitions](https://developer.akamai.com/api/core_features/open_api): Downloadable OpenAPI specifications for Akamai APIs.
- [CLI](https://developer.akamai.com/cli): Akamai CLI overview, installation, and package ecosystem.
- [Authentication](https://developer.akamai.com/api/getting-started): Getting started with Akamai API authentication and request signing.

## APIs and Developer Tools
- [API Reference](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/api): Central index of Akamai API documentation and references.
- [Akamai APIs](https://developer.akamai.com/api): Browse Akamai APIs by product and capability.
- [CLI Packages](https://developer.akamai.com/cli/packages): Available Akamai CLI packages for common workflows and automation.
- [Terraform Provider](https://techdocs.akamai.com/terraform-provider/docs): Infrastructure as code provider documentation for Akamai resources.
- [EdgeWorkers CLI](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edgeworkers/docs/akamai-cli): CLI support for EdgeWorkers deployment and management.
- [Postman Collections](https://developer.akamai.com/api/core_features/postman_collections): Postman resources for exploring and testing Akamai APIs.

## Security
- [App and API Protector](https://techdocs.akamai.com/application-security/docs): Documentation for web application and API protection on Akamai.
- [API Security](https://techdocs.akamai.com/api-security/docs): Protect APIs with discovery, posture, and runtime security capabilities.
- [Bot Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/bot-manager/docs): Detect, classify, and mitigate automated bot traffic.
- [Account Protector](https://techdocs.akamai.com/account-protector/docs): Defend login, signup, and account workflows from abuse.
- [Page Integrity Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/page-integrity-manager/docs): Monitor client-side script behavior and browser-side threats.
- [Prolexic](https://techdocs.akamai.com/prolexic/docs): DDoS protection and routed defense documentation.
- [Guardicore Segmentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/guardicore-segmentation/docs): Zero trust microsegmentation for data center and cloud workloads.

## Delivery and Edge
- [Ion](https://techdocs.akamai.com/ion/docs): Performance optimization and intelligent delivery for web experiences.
- [Adaptive Media Delivery](https://techdocs.akamai.com/adaptive-media-delivery/docs): Streaming media delivery and optimization documentation.
- [Media Services Live](https://techdocs.akamai.com/media-services-live/docs): Live video packaging and delivery workflows.
- [Image and Video Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/image-and-video-manager/docs): Automated image and video optimization at the edge.
- [Edge DNS](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs): Authoritative DNS configuration and traffic management.
- [Global Traffic Management](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs): DNS-based traffic steering and failover controls.
- [Property Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/property-mgr/docs): Configure and manage edge delivery behavior for properties.

## Compute and Edge Applications
- [EdgeWorkers](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edgeworkers/docs): Serverless JavaScript execution at the Akamai edge.
- [EdgeKV](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edgekv/docs): Distributed key-value storage for edge applications.
- [Cloudlets](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloudlets/docs): Edge logic for redirects, routing, and request handling.
- [API Acceleration](https://techdocs.akamai.com/api-acceleration/docs): Improve API performance and reliability over the Akamai edge.
- [Application Load Balancer](https://techdocs.akamai.com/application-load-balancer/docs): Load balancing for applications using Akamai edge services.
- [MCP API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/mcp-api/docs): API for managing cloud and hosting resources.

## Cloud Computing and Networking
- [Akamai Cloud Computing Docs](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs): Documentation for Akamai cloud compute, storage, and networking services.
- [Linode API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/docs): API reference for Akamai cloud computing resources formerly under Linode.
- [NodeBalancers](https://techdocs.akamai.com/nodebalancers/docs): Load balancing configuration for cloud compute instances.
- [Object Storage](https://techdocs.akamai.com/object-storage/docs): S3-compatible object storage setup and management.
- [VPC](https://techdocs.akamai.com/vpc/docs): Virtual private cloud networking and segmentation documentation.
- [Cloud Firewall](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-firewall/docs): Network-level firewall controls for Akamai cloud resources.
- [Kubernetes Engine](https://techdocs.akamai.com/kubernetes/docs): Managed Kubernetes deployment and operations guidance.

## Network Operator and Enterprise Access
- [Enterprise Application Access](https://techdocs.akamai.com/enterprise-application-access/docs): Zero trust access to internal applications and services.
- [Secure Internet Access Enterprise](https://techdocs.akamai.com/sia-enterprise/docs): Secure web gateway and internet access controls.
- [SASE](https://techdocs.akamai.com/sase/docs): Secure access service edge architecture and product documentation.
- [DNSi](https://techdocs.akamai.com/dnsi/docs): Recursive DNS security and policy enforcement.
- [App Platform](https://techdocs.akamai.com/app-platform/docs): Platform services for deploying and operating applications.
- [TrafficPeak](https://techdocs.akamai.com/trafficpeak/docs): Network traffic visibility and analytics documentation.

## Configuration and Operations
- [Control Center Help](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/control-center-help): Help for Akamai Control Center workflows and administration.
- [Identity and Access Management](https://techdocs.akamai.com/iam/docs): Manage users, roles, API clients, and access policies.
- [Certificate Provisioning System](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cps/docs): Provision and manage TLS certificates on Akamai.
- [DataStream 2](https://techdocs.akamai.com/datastream2/docs): Stream Akamai logs and telemetry to external destinations.
- [Reporting](https://techdocs.akamai.com/reporting/docs): Access traffic, security, and performance reporting data.
- [Purge](https://techdocs.akamai.com/purge-cache/docs): Invalidate cached content across the Akamai platform.
- [Diagnostics](https://techdocs.akamai.com/diagnostics/docs): Troubleshooting and diagnostic tools for Akamai services.

## Learning and Support
- [Release Notes](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/release-notes): Product and documentation release updates across Akamai TechDocs.
- [What's New](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/whats-new): Recent additions and changes in Akamai documentation.
- [System Status](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/system-status): Service status and operational information for Akamai platforms.
- [Community](https://community.akamai.com/): Community discussions, knowledge sharing, and peer support.
- [Akamai Blog](https://www.akamai.com/blog): Product, security, and platform insights from Akamai.
- [Support](https://www.akamai.com/support): Customer support resources and service assistance.
